treasures.name: Wat Xieng Thong
treasures.subtitle: Golden-city heritage
treasures.description: A Luang Prabang temple complex known for sweeping layered roofs, gilded decoration and colourful mosaic work.

treasures.name: Kuang Si Falls
treasures.subtitle: Turquoise cascades
treasures.description: Forest waterfalls spill over limestone terraces into a series of blue-green pools near Luang Prabang.

treasures.name: Pak Ou Caves
treasures.subtitle: Sanctuaries above the Mekong
treasures.description: Riverside limestone caves hold collections of Buddha images above the meeting of the Mekong and Nam Ou rivers.

treasures.name: El Nido
treasures.subtitle: Limestone & lagoons
treasures.description: Palawan’s coast around El Nido combines limestone cliffs, sheltered coves and clear-water island scenery.

treasures.name: Chocolate Hills
treasures.subtitle: Bohol’s rolling landscape
treasures.description: Grass-covered limestone hills rise across inland Bohol, with colours that shift between green and brown through the seasons.

treasures.name: Batad Rice Terraces
treasures.subtitle: Living mountain heritage
treasures.description: An amphitheatre of rice terraces surrounds Batad village, part of the UNESCO-listed rice terraces of the Philippine Cordilleras.

treasures.name: Petronas Twin Towers
treasures.subtitle: Kuala Lumpur’s skyline
treasures.description: Twin steel-and-glass towers linked by a skybridge rise above Kuala Lumpur City Centre.

treasures.name: Batu Caves
treasures.subtitle: Temples in limestone
treasures.description: A Hindu temple complex occupies limestone caves north of Kuala Lumpur, approached by a long staircase beside a towering Murugan statue.

treasures.name: Mount Kinabalu
treasures.subtitle: Above Borneo’s forests
treasures.description: Granite peaks rise above the forests of Kinabalu Park in Sabah, a UNESCO World Heritage site.

treasures.name: Omar Ali Saifuddien Mosque
treasures.subtitle: A golden dome by the lagoon
treasures.description: A gold-domed mosque and ceremonial lagoon form a landmark in the heart of Bandar Seri Begawan.

treasures.name: Kampong Ayer
treasures.subtitle: Life above the river
treasures.description: Water-village neighbourhoods built on stilts spread across the Brunei River, connected by walkways and water taxis.

treasures.name: Ulu Temburong National Park
treasures.subtitle: Rainforest from above
treasures.description: Protected rainforest in eastern Brunei offers river journeys, forest trails and a canopy walkway above the trees.
